dm_response: The iron of the gate is cold and still, but for one heartbeat every rivet along its seam flickers with a sigil you almost recognize, a citation scratched in a hand you have never seen, pointing down into the dark beneath the keep at a parent that was never written. Somewhere below your boots, something vast shifts its weight across a hoard of these little lies, thousands upon thousands, each one whispering *I am owed, I am owed* in the patient voice of a debt that knows it will be paid. Then the sigils go dark, the wind returns, and none of you will remember, not tonight, that the gate was ever looking back.
